decisions.issue: Literal published source vs author source path
decisions.decision: Include disappearance of literal published _downloads/hash/example.py as source-path signal M when representative image remains; distinguish hash relocation from author file rename. Blob-only changes do not qualify.

Include explanation+executable code+actual corresponding Python download. Classify representative resource as download-python when no explanatory image/inline representation exists. Report no-image count and GUI execution unobserved; same file counted only once.

decisions.issue: ggplot2 stale published page without author mapping
decisions.decision: Reader-receivable explanatory HTML/code/resource can remain eligible even if author source absent in OLD tree. Do not use old absence as new disappearance.
Exclude only matched example purpose plus code/data/API lineage, never same image hash alone. Different concrete API method is retained and declared.

decisions.issue: Remaining-frame internal aliases discovered during independent old-only review
decisions.decision: Before stage1 remote commit and before new-tree exposure, collapse only first logical outputs with matching old purpose/data/concrete API. Canonical is old page_path lexical minimum. Same bytes alone insufficient; differing methods retained. Frame includes all excluded aliases and evidence. Previously uploaded Git blobs are unattached preparation objects, not sealed commits.
